name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
description: National database and registration of unorganised sector workers to extend social security benefits.
benefits: e-Shram card; eligibility for future social security/welfare schemes; portability.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59, not members of EPFO/ESIC, with Aadhaar.
processing_time: Instant card generation after Aadhaar OTP verification.
validity: Card valid; update on change of details.
